raw:
Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 10
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner directed the search toward a non-authoritative third-party site (MVOTD) to “pull the actual list of animals,” relying on page metadata/keywords rather than an official BBC Earth source. This introduced conflicting cues (e.g., “macaroni penguin” vs. “rockhopper penguin”) and risked a misidentification instead of verifying via the official YouTube description, captions/transcript, or BBC Earth’s own social posts, leading to a wrong or unverified species conclusion.
